rationale: Two direct shared-D1 commercial audio offline-license UPDATE and INSERT SQL sites are physically removed from the original audio endpoint and replaced by typed, fail-closed private-owner-issued licenses. Owner independently rechecks exact legal scope, canonical purchase, device, risk hold, narration rights and source-derived manifest; only then grants the signed offline token lease.

files.review: The shared endpoint retains only purchase/device reads and cryptographic signature creation; its status revocation and license row insert are owner-only. Two nonauthorizing buyer playback writes retain unchanged SQL identities with source SHA re-fingerprinted.
